name: mail-templates
description: Trinity Mail React Email templates: branded, German-first (en fallback) transactional emails (verify, password-reset, magic-link, welcome, receipt, generic-notification) with a preheader-aware base layout, vendored brand theme, tiny i18n, and a renderEmail() helper that emits both HTML and a plain-text alternative for multipart sends
postMessage: Installed to emails/. 1) Render any template to a multipart pair: `const { html, text } = await renderEmail(<VerifyEmail userName="..." verifyUrl="..." />)`. 2) Pass it straight to the mail-client template: `await mail.send({ to, subject, html, text, category: 'auth' })` — both parts are required for deliverability. 3) Templates default to German (`locale="de"`); pass `locale="en"` for the English fallback, and `brandName` to brand the header/footer. Preview in the React Email dev server or just call renderEmail. Tests: `npx vitest run emails`.
